encoding: planar int16 x (0.25 m), uint16 y (0.01 m above yOffsetM), int16 z (0.25 m)

roofColour.encoding: uint8 r,g,b,measured per building, in the order of `buildings`
roofColour.surfaceEncoding: little-endian uint32 vertexStart + uint8 r,g,b per roof surface that differs from its own building; 7 bytes each, ascending by vertexStart
roofColour.method: median of the DOP20 drape pixels inside each building's LoD2 roof outlines, with green-dominant pixels rejected and the darkest and brightest fifths trimmed, then re-centred in value to remove the aerial sun (tools/geodata/roof_colour.py)
roofColour.wallsAreNotMeasured: Wall colour is NOT derived from any survey. A wall is not visible in a vertical aerial photograph. Each building's `wall` class comes from its measured ALKIS function code, its measured size and, where the site operator is tagged, the operator tag; the colour that class is painted is a convention.

wallClasses.basis: ALKIS bldg:function plus the building's own measured footprint and height; buildings inside a footprint the site's ownership test accepted are treated as institutional whatever the cadastre calls them, because a large share of an institutional site is tagged 31001_9998 'unspecified' while carrying a clearly institutional building name. The CLASS is measured; the colour it is painted is a convention.
